definitions.explanation: A shelf located in the upper part of a cabinet, closet, or storage unit. Used especially of the overhead luggage rack on trains and buses.

examples.japanese: {上棚|うわだな}に{荷物|にもつ}を{置|お}いた。
examples.english: I put my luggage on the upper shelf.

examples.japanese: {上棚|うわだな}の{箱|はこ}は{重|おも}くて{取|と}れない。
examples.english: The box on the top shelf is too heavy to take down.

examples.japanese: {電車|でんしゃ}の{上棚|うわだな}にカバンを{忘|わす}れてしまった。
examples.english: I left my bag on the overhead rack of the train.

notes:
Compound of {上|うわ} (upper) + {棚|たな} (shelf), with {棚|たな} voicing to だな in compounds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {上棚|うわだな}に{置|お}く: to place on the upper shelf
- {上棚|うわだな}から{取|と}る: to take down from the upper shelf
- {電車|でんしゃ}の{上棚|うわだな}: overhead rack on a train

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {下棚|したな}: lower shelf — the opposite position
- {網棚|あみだな}: overhead luggage rack (specifically the mesh rack on trains) — more specific than {上棚|うわだな}
